provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, T3 Virgin Islands (Virgin Islands Code Annotated)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), T3 Virgin Islands (Virgin Islands Code Annotated), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: Indigo prints V.I. Code Ann. tit. 1, § 97-89 (2015).
Under V.I. Code Ann. tit. 14, § 1052, the charge stands.

negative: The V.I. Code Ann. volumes are blue.
Title 14 of the V.I. Code covers crimes.
V.I. Code Ann. tit. 5 is the procedure title.
